items.title: Jornada de lucha frente al Congreso del colectivo de discapacidad, jubilados y movimientos sociales
items.description: El miércoles 21, colectivos de la discapacidad, jubilados y movimientos sociales se concentraron frente al Congreso de la Nación en el marco de una mega-sesión donde el Gobierno buscaba imponer su agenda. Camioneros y la Bancaria acompañaron con ollas populares y mate cocido, mientras el Frente de Lucha Piquetero se sumó tras marchar a Desarrollo Social por salario para las cocineras de comedores populares. El saldo legislativo fue la media sanción de una Ley de Fortalecimiento del Sistema de Discapacidad, que contiene parte del contenido de la Emergencia en Discapacidad, y la restitución de la Ley de Tierras con la eliminación de un artículo del DNU 70/2023. items.title: DBP engages with the public on peace: ‘We will develop a roadmap’
items.description: The Democratic Regions Party (DBP) is holding public meetings in various cities under the slogan “Building the language of peace together with the people” to promote broader public participation in the peace and resolution process. The meetings, attended by party leaders, co-chairs, members of the Central Executive Committee (MYK), and Party Council members, are continuing across numerous cities in Kurdistan. Aiming to reach a broad cross-section of society, from workers and civil society organizations to different faith communities and political groups, the DBP seeks to listen to the public’s expectations and proposals during these meetings and develop new policies concerning the process. ‘

items.title: Solidarity has to move beyond statements
items.description: General Strike U.S. names the systems that tie our struggles together: capitalism, imperialism, colonialism, white supremacy and state repression. Because those systems are connected, solidarity has to move beyond statements, symbolism and idealism. It has to be rooted in practice and in material struggle together. From the workshop "Many Struggles, One Fight: Building Autonomous Intercommunal Power, Direct Action Strategies and Revolutionary General Strike Networks" at the 2026 International Workshops. items.title: Ruşen Yakut: Policies of impunity in femicide cases must end
items.description: According to Ruşen Yakut of the Rosa Women’s Association, the growing number of femicides in Turkey and Kurdistan reflects a systematic, patriarchal structure of violence. Militarization, state repression, and impunity for perpetrators are exacerbating the situation, while state protection mechanisms frequently fail. In an interview with ANF, Yakut calls for a fundamental shift in policies concerning women, Turkey’s return to the Istanbul Convention, and the consistent criminal prosecution of violence against women. “We are living through a period in which femicides are increasing dramatically. items.title: What a revolutionary general strike asks
items.description: General Strike U.S. says a reactionary strike is stepping away from work, and the powers involved eventually return to the system. A revolutionary general strike asks what happens when we withdraw our labor, our energy, our skills, our purchasing power and our participation and redirect them toward our communities. That is built collectively, by connecting resources and creating alternatives. items.title: Capitalism pushes us away from each other
items.description: In the Q&A, the speaker says care reaches past childcare. It is also how we care for each other in our communities, and that is something we are still not so good at. Capitalism pushes us away from each other all the time, and going against that is hard and necessary work.
